name: Field Horsetail
desc: Field Horsetail (Equisetum arvense): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Equisetum arvense, commonly known as field horsetail or common horsetail, is a species of vascular plant in the horsetail family Equisetaceae. Like all horsetails, it is a type of fern.
